Data:Leiter.elie.persistent.ally.ys.json.desc: 'My first calling: to preserve what exists. My second calling: to preserve what exists as it is. An alliance with Ys will do little for the second; but it is necessary for the first.'

Data:Leiter.elie.persistent.foe.nowhere..desc: 'I was called on to extract a Worm from the spine of a shepherd. It had been in there almost twenty-eight days, but it showed no signs of development. I have learnt of other such cases: the Worms are weakening. I will not speculate as to why. I do not trust it yet.'

Data:Leiter.elie.persistent.json.desc: Black Elie's schemes have been frustrated; the Institute is not what she hoped. Elie has lifetimes of patience to draw on; but her remortal status has given her a new sense of urgency, and she will not be content to let the Institute go its own way for very much longer.

Data:Leiter.elie.persistent.mission.peac.desc: 'For so long I have striven to keep the world afloat. So many times, my efforts have been undermined by treachery. This Institute has done nothing like that… yet. I dare to hope.'

Data:Leiter.fraser.ally.carapace.json.desc: 'Now, at last, I can express my inner nature. I have established a joint endeavour with the returning Cross: their burrowings beneath the earth, my own mining operations. Our co-operation has made the Institute monstrously wealthy… and I confess that it has done my fortune no harm, either.'

Data:Leiter.fraser.ally.ys.json.desc: 'Ys might have been the greatest danger we had ever faced. It was wise of us to make common cause with them. And early indications are that trade with them will be very profitable - very profitable indeed. No cause for concern, there. I understand how to safeguard our interests and maintain our necessary quarantines.'

Data:Leiter.fraser.foe.carapace.json.desc: 'I am tolerated, but I am not trusted. I have proved myself a dozen times, and I am not trusted. I have suppressed my Cross-nature, though it cost me dear in dreams, and still I am not trusted. Well: I am patient. One day, we will see.'

Data:Leiter.fraser.json.desc: Fraser has been emphatic in his disappointment that the Institute does not engage with the Carapace Cross. But for now, his and the Institute's relationship remains mutually beneficial and mutually profitable.

Data:Leiter.fraser.mission.peace.json.desc: 'We might have made more of the opportunities the war granted us. But I have honoured the Institute's scruples. And our funds are sufficient for our needs. Still, I hope the Institute will make better use of my talents, another time.'

Data:Leiter.fraser.mission.stone.remembe.desc: 'I have made common cause with the presences that remain in the earth and the sea, just as the Institute directed. They have been very useful to my mining interests; we have unearthed unexpected treasures.'

Data:Leiter.hokobald.ally.chandler.json.desc: 'It is a very great pity - that the New King came so far, only to die at Caen in this silly War of earth. I have no patience for heroes. But there are flames that still burn in darkness. The Chandler is only delayed, not denied, and when he arrives, the Institute will share in his bounty. Or, perhaps, hers... I have a theory. I will share it only when I know I am correct. In the past, I have been too generous.'

Data:Leiter.hokobald.json.desc: Hokobald attends every meeting of the Institute, to thunder his complaints about its principles, its operations, its other founders… it seems unlikely that he would enjoy the meetings nearly as much without so many things to complain about.

Data:Leiter.hokobald.mission.better.gods.desc: 'I have wrought what no other might; I am justly accounted the greatest among the Forge-kind! The gods of gold and bronze are my children, and they bestride the Continent! At some point I will have to take them in hand - they have strayed a little from my original devising - but it is well wrought indeed. I think at our next meeting I shall propose a change of the Institute's name, to more properly honour my labours.'

Data:Leiter.hokobald.mission.secrecy.jso.desc: 'Secrets, like the great treasures of art and of the table, are not to be wasted on the peasantry. There has been altogether too much liberality in these respects, of late. With the Institute's assistance, I have been doing my best to correct that.'

Data:Leiter.morgen.ally.carapace.json.desc: 'You will recall I made a little friend at the opera - that singer who had the Cross-nature? Well, she has gone on to distinguish herself, and our friendship has… persisted.'

Data:Leiter.morgen.foe.carapace.json.desc: 'When there are insects in one's kitchen, one does not consume them. One takes the appropriate measures. I have helped the Institute take those measures…'

Data:Leiter.morgen.foe.devourers.json.desc: 'Irony? I have always enjoyed irony. A Ligeian sits in their councils, directing their operations against my un-cousins and my un-sisters… for whom I have little affection. And this Institute is grown quite powerful indeed. I prefer to be inside the council-chamber than without.'

Data:Leiter.morgen.json.desc: Morgen seems increasingly bored by the Institute's work. She may not remain Secretary Persistent very much longer. But a great deal has changed in the world: perhaps it's time to learn whether the Institute really needs a Secretary Persistent at all.

Data:Leiter.morgen.mission.autarchy.json.desc: 'I am so very glad I kept Zuthi's Roost-secrets safe. If the Roost still meets, none may guess where; and we have a treasure like the fruits and seeds of a new earth.'

Data:Leiter.morgen.mission.corrivality.j.desc: 'Others die so that we may persist. I learnt that long before I consumed my first infant. We all of us show our teeth when we smile, hein? I am smiling now. I am so grateful I was asked to ensure the persistence of this Institute.'

Data:Leiter.morgen.mission.stone.remembe.desc: 'I had always had a great sympathy with the gods-from-stone. Yes, I had hoped we might one day feast upon them, but I often feast on those with whom I have sympathy, is it not so? And I have noticed that the Sun, some days, is redder. I wonder what it would be, to share one's blood with the Sun.'

Data:Leiter.olympe.ally.reckoners.json.desc: 'The Reckoners are different since the War. Some of them are worse. But some of them, since they had to operate in public, have become… oh, not better. I shan't fool myself. But at least more careful.'

Data:Leiter.olympe.foe.carapace.json.desc: 'I regret what's happening with the Cross. There's been too much of that in Europe these last few years. But there really isn't room for them and us both - ontologically speaking, I mean…'

Data:Leiter.olympe.json.desc: 'So much has been lost,' Olympe likes to say, 'but without us it would have been so much worse.' It's not clear whether she believes it.

Data:Leiter.olympe.mission.peace.json.desc: 'I was in Kerisham again last week, for a meeting with what's left of the Obliviates. The sea is very strange there now. Bodies cast up on the beach every day - bodies of people who never existed and certainly never died…  but I think they might have died in another History? I don't know. So much has been lost, but without us, it would have been even worse.'

Data:Leiter.olympe.mission.revelation.js.desc: 'I remember Venice. The Skewbald Aria, the skewbald roses. The days when Calyptra seemed unassailable, and yet the Moth assailed her; how far we've come! All those secrets opened, carelessly, like poisoned presents for children. The biggest story of my career, and my name is nowhere near it... but I don't think I could bear more than a little of the responsibility.'

Data:Leiter.rowena.persistent.foe.ys.jso.desc: ''My Kelemdu… Ys had its due…always… Wolf-long… drowned… the priestesses… watchful as Spinthre, cunning as Stars. I know; for I was of their kind… but not… a pale dawn… palest...'

Data:Leiter.rowena.persistent.json.desc: Rowena rarely attends meetings in person. When she does, she speaks elliptically, pleadingly, sometimes wisely. She licks her lips, desperately. Her beauty is moonlight, mirror, bone.

Data:Leiter.rowena.persistent.mission.se.desc: '… the last shield of the Marches... Calyptra… not our enemy… truth, the final flower…'

Data:Leiter.serena.foe.chandler.json.desc: 'The Chandler has passed her appointed time, and she has not entered the world. Perhaps that means we have succeeded. Perhaps she was only ever a symbol for the fires that have passed. Or perhaps she is among the uncounted Hours now… I will not believe it yet; I will not let us relax our guard.'

Data:Leiter.serena.foe.ys.json.desc: 'Ys is the enemy of consistency. That does make them the enemy of Eternity. But it also makes them the enemy of librarians.'

Data:Leiter.serena.json.desc: Serena was disappointed to see that the Institute was not what she hoped: not a true heir to the Curia, to the St Rhonwen Trust, or any of her other shadowy schemes. But she works with it as best she can. Serena has always been a pragmatist.

Data:Leiter.serena.mission.autarchy.json.desc: 'It was all so much simpler, when I was Librarian. I miss those days terribly. It was so frustrating then - haggling over Bureau requests, trying to find a supplier who would deliver lapsang souchong to the village… those stupid dinners with Collers… now, though, I would give almost anything to go back. But that's HIstory.'

Data:Leiter.serena.mission.peace.json.desc: 'I remember the business with Zidane, his Lark project, the Roost-secrets. I had thought that by returning them, we would help keep the peace. And a scant handful of years later, this War in the Sun. But perhaps we delayed it. And even if we did not - I still believe it was the right thing to do...'

Data:Leiter.serena.mission.revelation.js.desc: 'I remember when we crippled Fissifer. I wonder if things would have been different, if we had not? Would the New King have lived? Might we even have avoided war? But perhaps the opposite is true. Perhaps it would have been even worse. Well: we have given many more the opportunity to make these choices.'

Data:Leiter.stanislav.ally.carapace.json.desc: 'I had hoped that we and the Cross would understand each other. That has, so far, proven to be too optimistic. As the zone of their return widens, the tensions grow… but I am doing what I can.'

Data:Leiter.stanislav.foe.carapace.json.desc: 'I had feared that we and the Cross would not understand each other. I did not wish to be right. It makes me despondent. But for now, I must treat the Change as if it were a sickness. I'm getting better at that.'

Data:Leiter.stanislav.json.desc: 'I am a healer before I am a priest,' Stanislav has been heard to say. He is not content with the direction the Institute has taken, but he is prepared to remain with the Institute as long as he feels he is advancing the first function.

Data:Leiter.stanislav.mission.peace.json.desc: 'I chose my path in Strasbourg. I am a healer before I am a priest. If that means that I take liberties with the capital-T Truth… well, there are many Histories. (I think there are still many Histories.)'

Data:Leiter.stanislav.mission.stone.cons.desc: 'Kitling Ripe, I recall, devoured the would-be immortals from the Lyterion. If I had known that was a harbinger of things to come… I might have chosen differently.'
